_method: One run per model, same prompt, no cherry-picking. Qwen-Image-2.1 ran locally (int8, RTX 3060 12 GB, 40 steps, seed 20260923, native 2K for text-to-image, 1536 px budget for edits). gpt-image-2 ran through ChatGPT/Codex on 2026-09-23. Verdicts are one reviewer's judgement of prompt adherence first, then realism and detail.

F1_retrato_pescador.title: Portrait: Patagonian fisherman
F1_retrato_pescador.note: Qwen renders extreme skin detail at 2K but overdoes it (HDR-looking wrinkles) and the background is a plain sea. GPT builds a believable harbor with natural skin.

F2_calle_lluvia.title: Street: San Telmo after rain
F2_calle_lluvia.note: Qwen looks like a real documentary street photo but ignores two details (couple 'in the distance', warm sodium light). GPT follows the prompt more closely but reads like a postcard.

F3_comida_medialunas.title: Food: medialunas and cortado
F3_comida_medialunas.note: GPT knows an Argentine medialuna is small, curved and glazed, and the newspaper is legible. Qwen draws large French croissants, gibberish newsprint and an espresso instead of a cortado.

F4_manos_luthier.title: Hands: luthier carving a scroll
F4_manos_luthier.note: Both hands are anatomically fine. Qwen carves an already varnished violin with an odd tool; GPT shows raw maple, a real gouge and plausible shavings.

F5_paisaje_fitzroy.title: Landscape: Mount Fitz Roy
F5_paisaje_fitzroy.note: The prompt asks for a still lake with a mirror reflection; only GPT delivers it. Qwen's Fitz Roy is recognizable but the lake barely reflects.

F6_producto_reloj.title: Product: watch on wet slate
F6_producto_reloj.note: GPT gives ad-ready framing with droplets on the crystal. Qwen leaves the softbox in frame and the watch small, though the wet slate texture is excellent.

C1_faro_libros.title: Surreal: lighthouse of books
C1_faro_libros.note: GPT hits every element: paper birds, ink sea with floating pages, coral palette, a beam of letters. Qwen draws real seagulls and a normal sea.

C2_poster_mardelplata.title: Poster with Spanish text
C2_poster_mardelplata.note: Both render every word perfectly, accents included. GPT also knows the real Rambla (Hotel Provincial, stone sea lions on pedestals) and has more poster punch.

C3_infografia_mate.title: Infographic: how to make mate
C3_infografia_mate.note: GPT: perfect small text and correct mate icons. Qwen misspells small captions ('Inclinar enj mate') and draws cups and a wine glass instead of a mate gourd.

C4_carpincho_astronauta.title: Character: capybara astronaut
C4_carpincho_astronauta.note: Both are feature-animation quality. Qwen reads 'mate gourd' literally and hands the capybara a raw calabash; GPT has it sipping mate through a bombilla.

C5_conteo_frutas.title: Counting: 3 apples, 2 pears, 1 banana
C5_conteo_frutas.note: GPT gets every count and position right. Qwen draws 2 apples and puts the banana off the plate.

C6_sticker_rgba.title: Transparent sticker (RGBA)
C6_sticker_rgba.note: Both return real alpha. Qwen again draws an East Asian hyōtan gourd instead of a mate.

E1_calle_nieve.title: Edit: sunny street → snowy night
E1_calle_nieve.note: Both keep the MARTINEZ sign, people, flower stand and architecture. Qwen is slightly more faithful to the source; GPT adds more of the requested warm light.

E2_retrato_ropa.title: Edit: change clothes, add glasses
E2_retrato_ropa.note: Identity, hair, expression, phone and background preserved in both. Professional in both.

E3_cartel_texto.title: Edit: rewrite a shop sign
E3_cartel_texto.note: Both replace SOLAR ROAST COFFEE with LA PORTEÑA CAFÉ, Ñ and accent included, in the same gold serif, leaving the logo and the rest of the photo untouched.

E4_cafe_sin_gente.title: Edit: remove all people
E4_cafe_sin_gente.note: Both remove everyone without ghosts. Qwen keeps the original table layout more exactly; GPT fills the interior with more life.

E5_perro_acuarela.title: Edit: photo → watercolor
E5_perro_acuarela.note: Both keep composition and pose. Qwen leans toward animation colors, GPT toward loose watercolor texture.

E6_multi_bici_perro.title: Edit: combine two photos
E6_multi_bici_perro.note: Both place the dog from photo 2 next to the bicycle with a contact shadow and matching light, bicycle unchanged.

E7_bici_recorte.title: Edit: remove background
E7_bici_recorte.note: Qwen cuts out the exact bicycle at its original position and scale, which is what you need for compositing. GPT redraws it larger and changes details of the rear rack.

E8_pared_quitar.title: Edit: remove an object
E8_pared_quitar.note: Both remove the rifle and rebuild the plaster; every frame is intact in both.
